time_policy.reported: none: no record carries a timestamp

identity_generation.note: The stream reports no response or tool-call ids; these Journal-generated ids are declared on the event basis and are not vendor ids.

rules.note: content unavailable at source: the stream step carries no prompt text

rules.usage: usage -> scope 2 Model response, status 0 Unknown (rule agy.stream.usage_status.v1: the vendor reports usage once with DONE and does not distinguish provisional from final)
rules.content: unavailable at source: the stream carries no response text

rules.result: tool_info.output when present -> tool_result.data; when absent, tool_result is ABSENT and reported_state DONE is recorded
rules.status: 0 Unknown, status_basis 3 Not derivable: DONE is a lifecycle state, not an outcome; no output and no error object
status_id 1 when result.status == SUCCESS (Reported run status; it does not assert every tool succeeded)
rules.usage: result.usage -> scope 4 Run status 2 Final (rule agy.stream.result_usage.v1)
rules.permission: result.denied_actions[] -> permission_decisions at scope 4 Run, decision_id 2 Denied, attribution 3 Unattributed with candidates = tool steps whose tool_name maps from action (command -> run_command) (rule agy.denial_candidates.v1); never attached to a tool_call

rules.selector: stderr text, blank, non-UTF-8 or non-JSON lines
